thread:
Alex: alerting — hosted-api 5xx rate jumped ~3x since the 3% canary rollout at 12:08 UTC. multiple customer reports about failures and high latency. stack: api-router -> gateway -> runtime.
Priya: confirming, seeing a surge of 503 / gateway timeout traces. top affected route: /v1/generate.
deploy-bot: canary roll started by jared@redwood at 2026-03-17T12:08:43Z. featureflag: adaptive-prefetch=true. traffic: 3% slice=customer-weighting-v2.
Jared: I rolled the prefetch flag to test batching improvements. didn't expect 503s. rolling steps were standard canary.
oncall-sre: any recent kernel/runtime switches for that slice? check kernelpath selection + prefetch config mapping.
Priya: logs show spike of upstream ECONNRESET and 504s in gateway around the same time. kv-cache miss ratio also up. snippet: ```[2026-03-17T12:09:02Z] route=/v1/generate trace=tx12345 upstream=runtime-12 status=503 error="kvcache timeout"```
Alex: multiple customer support tickets opened — some billing customers hitting errors repeatedly. flagged as P1 from support.
SupportBot: Customer escalations: CUST-842, CUST-903, CUST-914 — all reporting request failures and retries causing quota burn.
Megan: if this is a routing/toggle mismatch we should rollback the flag for the canary slice immediately and mitigate customer impact. need SRE + deploy owner to coordinate.
oncall-sre: reproducer from curl on canary slice: ```curl -v -H "x-redwood-traffic-slice: v2-test-3pct" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'``` -> hangs then 503.
Jared: quick check — the canary was accidentally mapped to kernel-selector v2 instead of fallback v1 for short sequences. v2 has the new prefetch path that needs a KV TTL tweak; without it some nodes block waiting on kvcache leading to timeouts.
Priya: that matches traces: long wait on kvcache fetch, then upstream close. latency distribution shift shows long tail at runtime-12/14.
Alex: customer impact: some automated retry loops doubled token usage. billing on those accounts spiking. support requests asking for credits.
Megan: ok action plan: 1) halt further rollout 2) flip adaptive-prefetch=false for the canary traffic slice 3) start rollback of canary mapping to kernel-selector v1 4) notify customers and billing. who takes 2/3?
Jared: I'll flip the flag and start a targeted rollback on the slice now. posting commands: ```rbctl feature toggles set adaptive-prefetch false --slice v2-test-3pct && rbctl rollout cancel canary-2026-03-17 --slice v2-test-3pct```
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: job-id=rb-88431, started by jared. ETA ~45s to propogate.
oncall-sre: while rollback runs, I'm bumping the shedder and lowering concurrency for the affected gateway to reduce retries. ```kubectl scale --replicas=...``` (ops commands omitted).
Priya: after rollback, we should run a small synthetic test: 100 requests against /v1/generate with slice header and confirm 200s and <100ms p95.
Jared: rollback completed. job-id=rb-88431 status=success. canary flag reverted.
Priya: metrics look much better, 5xx rate returning to baseline within 90s. KV miss rates down.
Alex: will ping customers in the three escalations threads and offer interim credits. raising billing ticket to assess cost impact.
Megan: please add a short postmortem note in #postmortems and block the adaptive-prefetch rollout until we add a kernel compatibility gate and improve kv TTL defaults.
Jared: will open an RFC for kernel-selection guardrails and add an automated check in rollout CI to ensure matching kernel & flag combos.
oncall-sre: follow-ups: (a) postmortem + signal runbook update (b) add metric alert for kvcache wait spikes (c) temporary rate limiter on retries for affected clients.
SupportBot: Escalation status: P1 -> mitigated after rollback. awaiting customer confirm.
Alex: closing slack thread for incident coordination, will update with postmortem link once written. :thumbsup:
